items.title: Special termination right due to price increase (must reach provider)
items.quote: Sie können binnen drei Monaten ab Zugang dieses Schreibens kostenfrei kündigen; der Vertrag endet frühestens mit Wirksamwerden der Änderung.
items.computation: This is a private-company letter, so the statutory 4-day delivery fiction for authorities does not apply; the period runs from actual receipt (Zugang), which is not stated. The letter is dated Friday 05.12.2025. Assuming normal domestic postal delivery of a few days, receipt is estimated at Monday 08.12.2025 (accounting for the intervening weekend). Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of receipt itself is not counted; a period of months ends, per §188 Abs. 2 BGB, on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the start day: 08.12.2025 + 3 months = 08.03.2026. That day is a Sunday, so under §193 BGB (period ending on a Sunday/holiday extends to the next working day, applicable to declarations such as a termination notice) the deadline moves to Monday 09.03.2026. Since the exact receipt date is an assumption, this date should be treated as an estimate; the actual deadline could be a few days later if the letter was delivered later than assumed.

warnings: The exact date the letter was received (Zugang) is not stated; the due date for the special cancellation right was estimated assuming delivery about 3 days after the letter's date (08.12.2025), which may not match the actual receipt date — check the envelope postmark or your own records if precision matters.

This is a private mobile-contract price increase, not an official authority letter, so the statutory administrative delivery-fiction rules do not apply; only the general civil-law period rules (§§ 187, 188, 193 BGB) were used.
